prompt: What did the officer articulate as the basis for frisking your client specifically?

options.label: Something specific to your client (e.g. visible bulge, furtive movement, matched a description)
General nervousness or presence in a high-crime area only
No suspicion articulated — the officer cited only the stop itself, officer safety in general, or your client's proximity to someone else

prompt: What did the officer do during the pat-down? Select all that apply.

options.label: Reached into pockets or clothing without first feeling something that could be a weapon
Removed an item that could not have been a weapon
Kept squeezing, sliding, or manipulating an object after it was clear it wasn't a weapon
